summary: The projective character-sum formula, the Betti count B, the unique-lift condition, the positive-embedding carry convention and the prime-conductor primary congruence all check out; I recomputed them by brute force and by short derivations. The 61-bit certificate replays independently: every primary-normalized profile generator has relative norm p^2 at all ten embeddings, lies in the Teichmuller-lifted ideal mod p^e_t, satisfies A(1)=1 and A'(1)=0 mod 11, and the 910 multiplicity-weighted sums reproduce the stored correction exactly. The headline keeps its stated conditions: a certificate under the local derivation, no LLL success theorem, and composite conductors not covered. Artifact counts match the text: 14 controls, 1032 records, 64 of 64 balanced LLL rows, 246 phase checks, 51 profiles for 200 records.

claims.quote: Character orthogonality gives this projective formula
claims.finding: Brute-force projective counts for (p,d)=(7,3),(13,4),(11,5),(29,7),(13,12),(17,8),(19,9),(61,4),(131,5) equal the stored point counts. The a+b+c=0 affine terms cancel against the boundary-curve correction, as the formula needs.

claims.quote: The number of terms is B=(d-1)(d^2-3d+3), and each has absolute value p
claims.finding: (d-1)^3-(d-1)(d-2)=(d-1)(d^2-3d+3). The a+b=0 case gives J=p*chi^a(-1), so |J|=p there too. A unique lift needs 2Bp+1<=p^2, which holds exactly when p>2B.

claims.quote: It satisfies e_t+e_(-t)=2 and sum e_t=phi(d)
claims.finding: S_t+S_(-t)=3d and S_t is never divisible by d when a+b+c!=0 mod d, so the two floors sum to 1. I brute-forced the true J(a,b,c) at p=29,d=7; p=13,d=4; p=11,d=5 (1366 prime/triple checks) and the exact valuation at the Teichmuller lift of eta^t matched e_t every time.

claims.quote: Thus this primary condition selects the correct root multiple of a balanced generator CLASSICALLY
claims.step: Prime Conductors Need No Phase Oracle
claims.finding: The count p^2-3p+3=1 mod ell is right, and so is the linear-coefficient divisibility (p-2)(p-1)(ell-1)/2. The residues of the 2ell roots 1-k*lambda and -1+k*lambda in Z[zeta]/lambda^2 are distinct. The test A(1)=1, A'(1)=0 mod ell is equivalent to A=1 mod lambda^2.

claims.quote: This is a checkable algebraic certificate under the stated local derivation
claims.finding: I replayed this independently of the producer: 51 profile generators, membership mod p^e_t, norm p^2 at all embeddings, primary congruences, and the 200-record correction 376191977256968888606, which equals #surface-(p^2+p+1). |C|<=910p and C=8=910 mod 11, as the primary congruence predicts. The scope wording (no LLL theorem, not an enumerated field) is kept.

claims.quote: LLL plus primary normalization reproduces all six prime-conductor native surface controls
claims.finding: In the artifact, exactly the six d in {3,5,7} controls have status CLASSICAL_PUBLIC_IDEAL_RECONSTRUCTION_COMPLETED with matching point counts. The eight composite-conductor controls are retained without that status, which matches the stated limitation to prime conductors.

summary: The cited Lenstra-Silverberg Theorem 1.3 does state a deterministic polynomial-time decide-and-compute algorithm for (CM-order, fractional ideal, totally positive w with I*bar(I)=Aw), with no GRH. The local application steps check out: the conjugation of split primes, I*bar(I)=p^2*A, the trace-Gram output bound, the group-ring lift with exact autocorrelation, and index p^ell. The only gap is one of scope. The bold Decision states classical polynomial-time exact counting outright, while the local application is review-pending and the imported recovery algorithm was never executed; the note concedes both elsewhere. Nothing is shown wrong.

claims.quote: Theorem 1.3, gives a deterministic classical polynomial-time decision AND recovery algorithm
claims.finding: arXiv 1706.07373 Theorem 1.3 takes a CM-order A, a fractional ideal I and a totally positive w with I*bar(I)=Aw. It decides whether some v has I=Av and v*bar(v)=w, and computes v if so, deterministically in polynomial time with no GRH. I did not check the Algorithm 18.x details.

claims.quote: Conjugation sends P_t to P_(-t). Since e_t+e_(-t)=2
claims.finding: bar(P_t) is the kernel of zeta->eta^(-t). p splits completely as the product of the P_t, so the product of P_t^2 is p^2*A, and w=p^2 is totally positive.

claims.quote: The trace Gram's smallest eigenvalue is1, so each |a_j|<=sqrt(ell-1)*p
claims.finding: Tr(J*bar J)=ell*sum a^2-(sum a)^2=(ell-1)p^2. The Gram matrix ell*I-11^T has eigenvalues ell and 1, so sum a^2<=(ell-1)p^2. The output size is polynomial.

claims.quote: Thus v has exactly known cyclic autocorrelation (p^2,0,...,0)
claims.finding: sum a_j=1 mod ell follows from primary J. v*bar(v)-p^2 vanishes in both the Q and Q(zeta) components of Q[C_ell], so it is zero. The artifact's normalized group-ring Gram determinant is 1 and the cyclotomic trace Gram determinant is ell^(ell-2) (3 for ell=3).

claims.quote: Its index is p^(sum e_t+1)=p^ell
claims.finding: X^ell-1 has distinct roots mod p (p!=ell), so the constraints decouple by CRT/Hensel. The index of (v) is |v(1)*N(J)|=p*p^(ell-1), which proves equality.

claims.quote: this published theorem plus the Jacobi identities and primary congruence gives classical polynomial-time exact surface counting
claims.finding: Read alone, the headline Decision asserts the classical algorithm outright. It does not carry the note's own conditions: the local reduction to Theorem 1.3 is review-pending, the Lenstra-Silverberg recovery algorithm was never executed, and polynomial succinct-input time needs the ell=poly(log p) promise stated later.

summary: I checked each load-bearing identity numerically on m=4, c=[2,3,5,7]. A^3=503*I. The Hermitian H^2 coefficient matrix at cut 2 has rank 4 and a 4x4 minor exactly equal to -4200-8400*omega, while A^2 has rank 3. E_r|0>=|r> holds. A random entangled pilot and its Bell-readout output give the same energy. The commutation phases for left and right multiplication follow from Z X = omega X Z. The paired-MPS tensor reproduces the output purification with bond 3D. Gate counts and the 56 rank records match the artifact. Every headline stays inside its stated scope.

claims.quote: the one-directional relation gives A^3=(sum c_j^3)I
claims.finding: U_l U_j=omega U_j U_l for l>j and U_j^3=I, so the q-binomial cross terms vanish at a primitive cube root of unity. The numerical check passes, and the artifact stores A_cubed_scalar=503=8+27+125+343.

claims.quote: minor with EXACT determinant -4200-8400*omega, nonzero in Z[omega]
claims.finding: H^2|0>, reshaped 9x9 at cut 2, has rank 4. Rows and columns (0,1,3,6) give determinant -4200-8400*omega, and -4200(1+2omega)!=0. The one-directional A^2 has rank 3, as stated.

claims.quote: there is no valid last vertex for that theorem's ordering
claims.finding: U_j commutes with U_j^dagger but omega-commutes with every other U_i, and U_i and U_i^dagger carry opposite phases. So with m>=2 no generator is uniform against all the others, and none can be placed last.

claims.quote: Thus for ANY normalized pilot, input and output have identical energy expectations
claims.finding: U_j E_r=omega^(sum_{i<j} r_i)E_(r+e_j), which matches U_j|r>. <0|X|0>=Tr(X)/3^m on span{E_r}. The numerical check with a random entangled 4-qutrit pilot agrees to 1e-15.

claims.quote: This is the ACTUAL output purification with bond at most3D
claims.finding: E_r|b>=omega^(sum_j r_j s_j)|b+r> with s_j=sum_{i<j} b_i, which gives exactly the stated tensor with a Z3 charge, so the bond is <=3D. The artifact's paired bond is 9 for pilot bond 3, and m(m-1)/2+2m=5 gates at m=2 matches.

claims.quote: cannot support an ENERGY-estimation separation here
claims.finding: The claim is conditioned on a constructible polynomial-bond controlled-precision pilot, and it explicitly excludes optimum-energy hardness and non-MPS sources. The intertwiner identity makes the pilot-MPS contraction equal to the output energy.

summary: The radius recurrence is correct. With independent labels, P_j times any product of earlier labels is a nonidentity Pauli, which gives equal sign multiplicities in each eigenspace. A Q anticommuting with every term exists because the symplectic form is nondegenerate, so the spectrum is symmetric. Anticommuting additions add c^2 to H^2. The dyadic enclosure width bound holds, because width stays a multiple of 2^-b and grows by at most 2^-b per root step; the 512-term artifact width is 330*2^-80. The recursive ground circuit's angle gives the lower eigenvector of [[-R,c],[c,R]], and the dependence counterexample is right.

claims.quote: Each eigenspace of H_(j-1) therefore has equal +1/-1 multiplicities for P_j
claims.finding: f(H_(j-1)) is a combination of products of earlier P_i. Multiplied by P_j, each product has a nonzero label sum, so it is traceless. Spectral projectors are polynomials, and P_j commutes with them.

claims.quote: Thus every H_j has a spectrum symmetric about zero
claims.finding: Independent labels make the map Q->(symplectic products with P_i) surjective, so a Q with all-one syndrome exists and QHQ=-H. With R_j=R_(j-1)+|c_j| and sqrt(R_(j-1)^2+c_j^2), this gives E_min=-R_m.

claims.quote: so interval width is at most (number of root steps)*2^(-b)
claims.finding: Exact Fraction additions keep the width a multiple of 2^-b. ceil(y)-floor(x)<(y-x)+2g, which is a multiple of g, so the width grows by at most one g per 1-Lipschitz root step. The 512-term certificate width is 165*2^-79, below 512*2^-80.

claims.quote: H_j restricts to [[-R,c],[c,R]]
claims.finding: Z_<j anticommutes with every canonical earlier term, so the Z-image of the ground state has energy +R. theta=-atan2(c,R) gives tan(theta/2)=-c/(R+S)=(R-S)/c, which is the lower eigenvector.

claims.quote: ZZI+IZZ+ZIZ has ground energy-1, not-3
claims.finding: The frustrated triangle has min s1s2+s2s3+s1s3=-1, and the labels sum to zero. P4 has no vertex uniform against all the others, so it cannot be ordered.

claims.quote: This falsifies the proposed ground-ENERGY separation, not HDQI correctness
claims.finding: The scope is limited to the optimum energy of the independent-label predecessor-uniform family, and the decision section keeps that scope. The artifact's four controls and the 512-term certificate are consistent.
